claim_boundary: analysis of existing fixed-weight traces using external train-only readouts; no claim of Demian adaptation, learning, self-readout, routing control, or causal mechanism
state_source: E-UNC-013 and E-UNC-014 immutable history-matrix artifacts; no trajectories are newly generated
primary_test: Fit cue6 ridge decoder and target-to-cue6 proper orthogonal tracker only on base-order allocated train histories. Freeze both. Score unseen paired histories within base order and heldout cue order. Compare true labels with conditional-label-shuffle and analytic latest-cue controls.
secondary_observers: time_conditioned_external: five fixed checkpoint blocks in the same 16-D projection; external checkpoint identity only
regime_conditioned_external: 16-D projection plus interactions with total-state log norm and gate-state mean; fit on base-order train histories only
controls_and_limits: All source manifests, state arrays, metadata and split summaries are SHA256-verified before use.
Transforms, standardization, decoder parameters and conditional-shuffle labels use allocated train histories only.
The orthogonal map is restricted to a fixed 16-D random projection; no full-state 1312-D rotation is fit from 32 samples.
No evaluation labels or evaluation-cloud fitting is used. Known checkpoint is allowed only as an external observer input.
Dynamic observer success is feasibility for an external readout, not evidence that Demian performs the same operation.
This is exploratory analysis on already-inspected matrix batches; any candidate requires a new preregistered seed confirmation.
decision_rule: The only primary correction is orthogonal_track. A candidate within-order result requires its frozen true-label decoder to exceed both analytic_latest and matched conditional_shuffle in every seed-by-projection cell at a delay. Cross-order portability is secondary and requires the same all-cell pattern. Failure means this fixed low-rank offline correction is insufficient; it does not negate information availability.
